title: Ludo Hero
description:
Ludo Hero, modern version of the royal game of Pachisi has arrived. It's a game which was played among Indian kings and queens in ancient times.

Roll the Ludo dice and move your tokens to reach the center of the Ludo board. Beat other opponents and become the king of Ludo in this multiplayer game.

No complicated login screens. Just enter your username and play against the world.

Play with your friends in a 2-player or 4-player mode.

title: Scala 40
description:
Scala 40 is an Italian card game played with two French decks and jokers.

Players form sets and runs to reach at least 40 points and lay down their first combinations.

Each turn, players draw and discard, trying to optimize their hand and use their own or opponents’ combinations.

The first player to run out of cards wins, while the others add up the points of their remaining cards.

title: Four Colors Multiplayer
description:
Four Colors is a HTML5 Card Games.
Face up to 3 computer-controlled opponents.
Match cards by color or number, play action cards to mix the game up and be the first to get rid of all cards.
Last but not least: Do not forget to press the 1 button when you have only one card left!

3 Game’s Mode: 
- Multiplayer mode 
- Play against the pc 
- Challenge a friend playing on the same device

title: Ludo Legend
description: Play a game of Ludo! Everyones favourite board game! Play alone or with your friends on one device! Just pass it on! Colorful design and easy mechanics will keep you playing for hours!

title: Master Chess Multiplayer
description:
Use the most effective strategies to defeat the computer or real players from all over the world in this classic game for all time.

The goal of the game is to capture your opponent's king. This is done by moving the pieces on the board.

Who will be the first to say ""Checkmate"".

To make a move, click on the shape and drag it to the desired position.

title: Ludo World
description: Experience endless fun with various vibrant environments, where every roll of the dice brings a new challenge. Choose between classic or quick mode, progress along the trophy road, and prove you're the master of the board with every move you make.

title: Master Checkers Multiplayer
description:
Master Checkers Multiplayer is a HTML5 Board Game. 
Enjoy this stylish version of the classic Checkers Game. 
3 Game’s Mode: 
- Multiplayer mode 
- Play against the pc 
- Challenge a friend playing on the same device

title: Drop 4
description:
Drop 4 is a logic game. 

Drop your discs into the columns of the game grid and make a line of at least four chips either vertically, diagonally, or horizontally -  before your opponent does!

Two Game Modes:

 - Challenge a friend using online multiplayer or from the same device!

 - Play against the pc!

title: The Chess
description:
'The Chess : A Clash of Kings' consists of traditional classic mode and special mode to break the chessboard randomly.
You can play a game, changing a board and piece at your preference.
Enjoy a game by changing it with any image you want.

title: Elite Chess
description: Enjoy classic gameplay with three chess modes, each offering varying time settings suited to your play style. Take your chess skills to the next level, climb the ranks from Bronze to Diamond, and strive to become a top chess player.

title: Domino World
description: Play a timeless game of dominoes where strategy rules and every move matters. Unlock exclusive trophies and collectible wooden sets as you progress. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts seeking endless fun and challenges.

title: Word Finder Board Game
description: Word Finder is a HTML5 Word Game.Squeeze your brain and find as many words as possible in two minutes!

title: Hotel Manager
description:
Have you ever dreamt of being one of the biggest landowners in the world?

Get your (virtual) chance in this extremely addictive game!

Build hotels all over the world, upgrade them and crowd your opponents out of the market, leaving their customers to come to you!

title: Tic Tac Toe Multiplayer
description:
Ultimate Tic Tac Toe is a HTML5 Board Game. 
Enjoy this nice version of the classic Tic Tac Toe Game. 3 Game’s Mode: 
- Multiplayer mode 
- Play against the pc 
- Challenge a friend playing on the same device

title: Mind Games for 2-3-4 Player
description: Mind Games is a huge game where you can find 2-3-4 player games while playing. The game consists of 27 games under various categories like skill games, Brain Games, matching games, pop-it games, mancala, ludo, and Tic Tac Toe games. Each of these games is fun and made for kids and it is safe to play. Most of these games can be played 2 player, 3 player or 4 player.

title: Mahjong Lines
description: Mahjong Lines is a relaxing logic puzzle in the mahjong connect style. Find matching tile pairs and clear the board by linking them with a valid path. With classic mahjong tiles, simple rules, hints, and lots of levels, it’s perfect for both quick sessions and thoughtful puzzle-solving.

title: Ludo Fever
description: Destroy enemy tokens in this modern Ludo. Play it alone, or with friends and family on one device. Roll the dice and go through the entire playing field with all the tokens. Will you come to the home area first?

title: UNO Heroes
description: UNO Heroes is a fun version of UNO with unique features Your main goal will be to free the locked Superheroes  you must win as many games as possible to do that The rules are simple especially since many of you already know how to play The player who is first left with no cards wins Dont forget to tap that UNO button when youre ready to let your second to last card go

title: Checkers Deluxe Edition
description:
It's a clash on the battlefield! Draw up your plan and defeat your opponents with finesse!

It is also known as the draughts game, and it is an interesting test of strategy. Compete with an opponent and dominate their pieces as best you can.

What happens when you manage to move a piece to the other end? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Snake and Ladders Multiplayer
description:
Snake and Ladders Multiplayer is a HTML5 Board Game. 
Enjoy this funny version of the classic Snake and Ladders Game. 
3 Game’s Mode:

- Challenge a friend playing on the same device

title: Domino Adventure
description: Discover three match durations to suit your style. Showcase your skills and logic in each round, and use strategic moves to outplay your opponents. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts seeking endless fun and challenges.

title: Ludo Play
description:
Old Classic Board game is back "Ludo Play". So like old times choose your color Red, Green, Blue and Yellow. 
Start getting into your own house. Enjoy!

title: Chess Duel
description: Master the art of chess with three exciting modes, each offering flexible time settings to suit every player. Take your chess skills to the next level, climb the ranks from Bronze to Diamond and strive to become a top chess player.

title: Ludo Star
description: Enter the arena of strategy and chance! Choose your favorite mode, unlock stylish dice skins and climb the trophy road. Outsmart opponents, master your moves and prove you’ve got what it takes to rule the board and become a Ludo Star.

title: L.O.L. Surprise Game Zone
description: Hi, B.B.s, welcome to the big city of L.O.L. Surprise! where you will visit the coolest shops, full of games and surprises.

3 Game’s Mode:

title: 2 Player Online Chess
description: Enjoy the classic game of chess with 2 Player Online Chess! Play solo against the computer or challenge a friend in 2-player mode. Easy to use, with no distractions—just simple, fun chess for everyone. Start playing today!

title: Parcheesi Deluxe
description: Parcheesi Deluxe is a variant game of Ludo, one of the most famous board game (It's also know as Pachisi or Parchis). The concept of this fun Parcheesi board game is clear: four players must beat their opponents by moving all of their tokens to their goal before everyone else.

title: Goose Game Multiplayer
description:
Goose Game Multiplayer is a HTML5 Board Game. 
Enjoy this funny version of the classic Goose Game. 
3 Game’s Mode: 
- Multiplayer mode 
- Play against the pc 
- Challenge a friend playing on the same device

title: Just Ludo
description: Just Ludo is a tabletop dice board game. Roll the dice and let your chess pieces reach the finish line first, so as to defeat the opponent and win rich rewards. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Backgammon Deluxe Edition
description:
Want to try a different kind of game of luck? Enjoy the best board game of luck, Backgammon Deluxe!

Challenge your friend to a game of chance and trust in the dice roll. Roll the dice with all your might and pray for a lucky number!

Who will come out on top in the end? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Drawing Squares
description:
Drawing Squares is the logic game that will blow your mind!
It is a logic game inspired by the classic pen and paper game Dots and Boxes. Do you remember the game you used to play at school? (also known as Boxes, Squares, Paddocks, Pigs in a Pen, Square-it, Dots and Dashes, Dots, Smart Dots, Dot Boxing, or, simply, the Dot Game).

title: Reversi
description: Challenge your strategic mind against the computer in difficulty levels from absolute novice to expert in this classic game of flipping disks.

title: Ludo
description: Get ready for the toughest battle with the Ludo game against three friends of you with the most classic board game. You should get your four characters to the area which is in the middle of the board and in the color of your tokens. You should roll six number with the dice to start moving with one of your tokens.  The Ludo game which can be played up to four players, begins!

title: Backgammon Duel
description:
One of the oldest, most played and loved games, the classic backgammon game. 

Also known as Tavli (Greece), Tawla (Egypt), and Takteh (Iranian), but whatever you call it you can download it now and challenge yourself.

title: Four In A Row
description: One of the best examples of classic games. The Four in a Row game is quite simple a game. Just bring four balls together and win. You can play with your friends or play against the computer. Play game now to have fun.

title: Chess Fill
description: Color all of the squares on the board by moving chess pieces over them. Chess pieces as they do in the game of Chess. 70 levels to complete!

title: Chess Move 2
description:
Defeat the Red King by strategically moving your pieces to get to the Red King's location.  There are 24 challenging levels in this game where you'll sometimes need to slide the gameboard halves or use the gravity switcher squares.  No time limit in this game so you can take your time and if you get stuck on a level you can always click the Video button on the Main Menu to see the walkthrough video.

You don't need to know how to play chess as the chess pieces in this game will display the squares they can move to when they are clicked.  In fact this can be a good introduction as to how chess pieces move!

title: FG Ludo
description: FG Ludo is fun addictive puzzle game.If you love ludo and want some twist. This game is for you. so enjoy the game.

title: Ludo Wars
description: A unique Ludo game! Challenge an online player or challenge a friend in local two player mode. Be the first player to move all of your pieces to the end goal. Watch out for trap spaces and enemy pieces.

title: Ultimate Yatzy
description: Ultimate Yatzy is the classic dice game that delivers endless fun and excitement. Roll five dice to score the best combinations and outsmart your opponents. Whether you're a casual player or a Yatzy pro, this game blends strategy and luck to keep you challenged and entertained. Aim for a Full House, a Straight, or the elusive Yatzy—every roll is a new chance to win.

title: 3D Chess Master
description: 3D Chess Master – The ultimate 3D chess experience! Enjoy stunning three-dimensional graphics while testing your strategy skills. Challenge your friends in head-to-head matches or take on powerful AI opponents in the most immersive chess game yet.

title: Mate in One Move
description: Mate in one puzzles collected according to the team of mating chessmen assisted by the king: lone rook, two rooks, lone queen, bishop with pawns, knight with pawns, rook with pawns, queen with pawns, just pawns, bishop pair, two knights, bishop and knight, queen and rook, two queens, rook and bishop, rook and knight, queen and bishop, queen and knight.

title: Reinarte Checkers
description: A classic checkers game with an 8x8 board, perfect for having fun and testing your strategies against a simple AI, just like a child.

title: Pyramid Diamonds Challenge
description: Enjoy a brand new diamonds game in the atmosphere of pyramids with "PYRAMID DIAMONDS CHALLENGE".  Have a lot of fun with this puzzle game, its exhilarating rhythm and its beautiful graphics.  Do your best to reach  the highest score in two game modes that will constitute a diversified challenge.

title: ChessField
description: Enter ChessField, a strategic battle chess game where classic moves meet action-packed arenas! Plan, fight, and outsmart rivals in epic chess battles across dynamic fields. Perfect for students searching cool math games, chess online challenges, or fun school break strategy. With addictive gameplay, smart tactics, and arcade-style twists, ChessField is the ultimate free kids game for fans of chess, battle chess, and strategy games.

title: Petits chevaux : small horses
description: You can play the game of small horses with 1, 2, 3 or 4 players. It's so great ! Find the board game of your childhood, with the little horses on your mobile or tablet. This great classic game, is simply one of the simplest games but also one of the best board games of all time. Play against artificial intelligence or against friends, and have as much fun as you want. Who will put all its horses in the first central box?

title: Tic Tac Toe - Match Three
description:
Rediscover the classic game of Tic-Tac-Toe (XO) like never before with "Tic Tac Toe: Match Three"! Immerse yourself in this timeless board and strategy game that's been masterfully reimagined to offer new puzzles, exciting challenges, stunning graphics, and endless fun for players of all ages. Whether you're looking for a quick game to sharpen your brain or a comprehensive puzzle game experience, our game has something for everyone.

Let the strategic battles begin!

title: Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey with Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure, where quick thinking and strategy collide in an exciting online card challenge. Build your deck, make smart moves, and face thrilling encounters that test your skills and timing. Designed for both desktop and mobile players, this free-to-play adventure delivers fast, tactical gameplay and endless replayability. Every decision shapes your path — can you conquer the quest in just ten minutes?

title: Dragon Egg
description: Players can unlock higher-level Divine Dragon eggs by moving three or more of them. Supports multi-level recursive synthesis of 5-color dragon eggs. Eventually, unlocking high-level dragon eggs can unlock the birth of new dragons, accompanied by splendid animations, filling the sense of achievement to the fullest.

title: Cars Traffic King
description: In this simple game you will try to control the traffic lights to avoid accidents between cars You must pass the lights properly to handle the trafficFeel like a controller of police traffic officer standing in the middle of a dangerous intersection Try to finish all levels with  stars

title: Daily Chess Puzzle
description: Enjoy over 700 daily chess puzzles in a sunny, beach-themed world. Lighthearted, relaxing, and perfect for summer fun anytime.

title: Fish Rescue
description: Its time to go home  but the poor little fishes are still looking for their anemone You have to help them  Draw the path they have to follow in the floor Avoid the big fhishes in the way and thats it Each level offers you a new puzzle that you will love for sure Fish Rescue tests your reflexes and logic This new game will make you think and work your memory The cute graphics are perfect for the young ones

title: Brain Teasers Colors Game
description:
This game is a simple puzzle game that is easy to learn & quick to play. This blaster will challenge your brain and your reflexes!

Brain Teasers : Game of Dots, you must burst dots to trigger a chain reaction in order to eliminate them. You need to eliminate all the dots to complete the level and pass to the next level. You have 400 levels to complete before finishing the game.

title: Push the Mouse
description: Do you like cute puzzle games This game is for you Push The Mouse is a super cute game that will put your intelligence to test can you help all the little miceTouch the mouse you want to move and hell move but mice are not very smart they only know how to advance in one direction so youll have to wrap your mind around that to help them arrive to their destination
